title: Answer
description:
A great High Priest has passed through the heavens and remains there. The earlier priest passed courts and a veil and came out again.

He was tempted as we are, and He was without sin. Where the people met hunger, thirst, and the promise with unbelief, He did not.

The throne is a throne of grace. Approach is no longer one man, on one day, with blood that must be brought again. Those who come may come boldly.
